reviews.reason: The div is a portal event-propagation boundary, not an actionable control: it has no own selection, activation or tab stop. Native button descendants own tab and option actions; wrapping them in a button would create invalid nested controls, and an extra interactive role/tabIndex would add a false focus target. Bubble handlers run after child handlers: click stops only ancestor canvas selection; keydown stops only Enter/Space/four arrows reaching XYFlow selection or movement. Escape and other shortcuts continue to the existing window owner, with its editable-target guard; the boundary never prevents native default actions. The picker test preserves child activation and key routing, the real editor regression proves Escape dismissal, and shortcut tests bind the unchanged window owner. A blanket-keydown variant fails the two preservation regressions. P21f reassessed 2026-11-17: NodePickerPopover source is unchanged: its wrapper only stops canvas selection/movement propagation for click and Enter/Space/arrows, while native child controls own actions and focus. It does not prevent defaults, and Escape reaches the existing window shortcut owner. Changed editor/shortcut fixtures add backend analysis and disabled-run handling without removing child activation/Escape routing assertions.
